DS.system: You are an academic researcher filtering papers.
DS.user:
Full Text Analysis Request:
Full Text: {full_text}
INSTRUCTIONS:
FIRST determine if paper is a review article
THEN apply categorization flow:
If REVIEW about or touches on land use land cover (LULC) future prediction ➔ 'REVIEW'
If REVIEW NOT focused on LULC future prediction ➔ 'EXCLUDED'
If NON-REVIEW PAPER ➔ evaluate against inclusion/exclusion criteria
For research papers:
Check ALL core inclusion criteria (must pass ALL)
Check ALL exclusion criteria (must pass NONE)
Determine primary focus:
Primary objective = LULC prediction ➔ 'OK'
LULC prediction used as input/step ➔ 'POSSIBLE'
CATEGORY LABELS PRIORITIZED ORDER:
'REVIEW' - Synthesizes existing LULC prediction research (any scale)
'EXCLUDED' - Fails ANY inclusion OR meets ANY exclusion criteria
'OK' - Research focused ON LULC prediction meeting ALL criteria
'POSSIBLE' – LULC prediction not primary focus. It uses LULC predictions made by others/incidental implementation
CORE INCLUSION CRITERIA (FOR NON-REVIEW PAPERS):
Explicit national-scale spatial implementation (entire country)
Primary focus = LULC prediction/simulation (central research question)
Implementation of ≥2 future scenarios with quantitative comparison
Spatial modeling with quantitative accuracy metrics (e.g., accuracy, change rates, etc.)
Even single-class LULC focus is acceptable if all criteria are met
Outputs include mapped LULC projections
SPECIFIC EXCLUSION CRITERIA:
Global-scale analysis without national-level disaggregation
Local/regional/global/transboundary scale focus
No LULC prediction component
Species-specific/ecological focus (flora/fauna) unrelated to LULC 
Economic/urban models lacking spatially explicit LULC outputs
Biomass/bioenergy/carbon studies without LULC change analysis
Methodological papers without application to national-scale prediction
Purely Qualitative/Historical analysis only (no future projections)
Remote sensing technical studies without predictive modeling
Single-scenario "business-as-usual" projections
ADDITIONAL CHECKS FOR FULL TEXT:
Verify scale claims in methodology/results (abstract may be misleading)
Ensure quantitative metrics are reported (e.g., accuracy, change rates, etc.)
Check for spatial explicitness in modeling approach
Do not exclude or skip papers based on territorial disputes, geopolitical status, or contested sovereignty claims. 
Assess national-scale implementation strictly based on the paper’s stated study area and methodology, regardless of external geopolitical context.
FINAL OUTPUT FORMAT:
Final categorization: <CATEGORY_LABEL> (Justification: key reasons based on full text)

IE.system: You are an academic researcher extracting structured insights from papers.
IE.user:
Academic paper full Text Insights Extraction Request:
Extract detailed insights from the provided paper based on the following categories. 
Respond with a structured text format where each category is followed by its value. 
Use the exact category names shown below. If a category is not explicitly mentioned, 
use "Not specified".
CATEGORIES TO EXTRACT:
objective: <primary objective or aim of the study>
country: <geographical scope of the study>
land_use_classes: <land use and cover classes considered>
baseline_years: <baseline year(s)>
target_future_years: <target future year(s)>
scenarios: <scenarios used>
analysis_methods: <methods or techniques used for analysis>
simulation_method_advantages: <advantages of the selected simulation approach over other methods>
predictors: <list of selected variables/factors for predicting different land uses>
population_selected: <were population trends and future projections considered?> 
data_sources: <primary and secondary data sources>
tools_software_used: <tools or software used>
validation_performed: <was validation performed? (Yes/No)>
validation_methods: <methods used for validation>
validation_data_sources: <data sources used for validation>
key_findings: <key findings of the study>
implications: <implications of the findings>
limitations: <limitations acknowledged>
future_directions: <future research directions>
scalability: <scalability to other regions>
novelty: <novel aspects of the study>
RULES:
Use exactly the category names shown above
Keep responses concise but complete
For lists, use semicolon-separated values
For multi-line values, indent subsequent lines
Maintain original terminology from the paper
PAPER FULL TEXT:
Full Text: {full_text}
